title: Export reviewed receipts to a shareable CSV
userStory: As a user I can export my reviewed receipts as a CSV file and share it.
acceptanceCriteria: App.js builds the sheet via buildReceiptSheet and shows a summary (row count + needs-review count) with an Export/Share button that calls exportShare.exportSheet (injectable writeFile/share).
The build-to-export wiring lives in a testable helper; App.js calls it and the button triggers it.
npm test passes: helper builds a sheet and calls export with the csv; App.js source renders the export button + summary.
